description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Soraka''' calls down a star upon the target location that grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area before landing after 0.25 – 1 (based on target range) seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Soraka calls down a star upon the target location that grants sight of the area before landing after 0.25 – 1 (based on target range) seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

description2.raw: If this hits at least one enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], star dust returns to '''Soraka''', granting her ''Rejuvenation'' for 2.5 seconds. While '''Soraka''' has ''Rejuvenation'', casting ''[[File:Soraka Astral Infusion.png|20xpx|border|link=Soraka#Astral Infusion|An icon for Soraka's ability Astral Infusion]] [[Soraka#Astral Infusion|Astral Infusion]]'' will also grant ''Rejuvenation'' to the target for the same duration.
description2.text: If this hits at least one enemy champion, star dust returns to Soraka, granting her Rejuvenation for 2.5 seconds. While Soraka has Rejuvenation, casting Astral Infusion will also grant Rejuvenation to the target for the same duration.

description3.raw: '''Rejuvenation''': [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|Heal]] every 0.2 seconds and gain [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed that decays over the duration.
description3.text: Rejuvenation: Heal every 0.2 seconds and gain  bonus movement speed that decays over the duration.

notes.raw: * ''Starcall'' counts as hitting even if it gets blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]], granting ''Rejuvenation''. * Both the initial hit and the ''Rejuvenation'' projectile can be [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|intercepted]]. * ''Rejuvenation'' heals over 12 ticks, with the first 4 each healing for about 15% of the heal, the next 4 ticks for about 5.5% each, and the last 4 for about 4.5% each. * ''Rejuvenation'' won't be granted to '''Soraka''' and she won't be able to make use of the health cost reduction on [[File:Soraka Astral Infusion.png|20xpx|border|link=Soraka#Astral Infusion|An icon for Soraka's ability Astral Infusion]] [[Soraka#Astral Infusion|Astral Infusion]] until the projectile gets to her, but she is able to ''Rejuvenate'' allies as soon as the target is hit.
notes.text:
Starcall counts as hitting even if it gets blocked by spell shield, granting Rejuvenation.
Both the initial hit and the Rejuvenation projectile can be intercepted.
Rejuvenation heals over 12 ticks, with the first 4 each healing for about 15% of the heal, the next 4 ticks for about 5.5% each, and the last 4 for about 4.5% each.
Rejuvenation won't be granted to Soraka and she won't be able to make use of the health cost reduction on Astral Infusion until the projectile gets to her, but she is able to Rejuvenate allies as soon as the target is hit.
